title: erodium cyrenaicum
intro: Erodium cyrenaicum, commonly known as Cyrenaica stork's bill, is a flowering plant species found in the Mediterranean region. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Erodium cyrenaicum include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal value.
